meta.tagline: Forums that connect, and leave a mark
meta.ministry: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
meta.description: The official platform for Athar Forums — an initiative by the Eastern Region Branch of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, bringing colleagues together around what they are good at and what they love.
meta.hook: Where the story begins, and the mark is made

teaser.heading: Athar Forums
teaser.lead: A space bringing Ministry employees together around what they are good at and what they love. Pick your forum, meet people who share the passion, and leave a mark beyond your desk.
teaser.formLead: Leave your official email and we will write the moment the forums open.

one.title: Pick your forum
one.body: Forums across disciplines — from media and technology to reading and volunteering. Choose what fits your skill or your curiosity.

two.title: Share your skill
two.body: Every forum is led by employees themselves. You learn, you teach, and you build with colleagues who share the interest.

three.title: Leave your mark
three.body: Events, workshops and initiatives that start inside the Ministry and reach well beyond it.
